name: Sendblue
description: Sendblue iMessage/SMS/RCS channel plugin for OpenClaw. Supports multiple accounts sharing a single webhook endpoint.
author: OpenClaw

webhookPort.description: Port for the webhook HTTP server (shared across accounts)

webhookPath.description: URL path for the webhook endpoint (shared across accounts)

webhookSecret.description: The Sb-Signing-Secret value Sendblue sends with every webhook request

accounts.description: Named accounts, each with its own Sendblue credentials and policy

fromNumber.description: Your Sendblue line number in E.164 format (e.g. +19293649402)

dmPolicy.description: Access control: open (anyone) or allowlist (only allowFrom numbers)

allowFrom.description: E.164 phone numbers allowed to message the bot (when dmPolicy=allowlist)

sendReadReceipts.description: Automatically mark incoming messages as read

apiKeyId.description: (Legacy) Sendblue API key ID — use accounts.{name}.apiKeyId instead

apiSecretKey.description: (Legacy) Sendblue API secret key — use accounts.{name}.apiSecretKey instead

fromNumber.description: (Legacy) Your Sendblue line number — use accounts.{name}.fromNumber instead

sendReadReceipts.description: (Legacy) Send read receipts — use accounts.{name}.sendReadReceipts instead
